changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: UPDATE catalog_items ci JOIN ( SELECT 'CORE' AS code, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(30)) AS area_code, 'Núcleo' AS short_label UNION ALL SELECT 'SCHEDULING', 'PATIENT_CARE', 'Agenda de citas' UNION ALL SELECT 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'PATIENT_CARE', 'Historia clínica' UNION ALL SELECT 'VACCINATION_DEWORMING', 'PATIENT_CARE', 'Vacunación' UNION ALL SELECT 'GROOMING', 'PATIENT_CARE', 'Spa y estética' UNION ALL SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER', 'FRONT_DESK', 'Caja y mostrador' UNION ALL SELECT 'SERVICES', 'FRONT_DESK', 'Tarifas y promociones' UNION ALL SELECT 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'FRONT_DESK', 'Cartera' UNION ALL SELECT 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING', 'FRONT_DESK', 'Facturación DIAN' UNION ALL SELECT 'HOSPITALIZATION', 'HOSPITAL', 'Hospitalización' UNION ALL SELECT 'SURGERY', 'HOSPITAL', 'Cirugía' UNION ALL SELECT 'LAB_IMAGING', 'HOSPITAL', 'Laboratorio' UNION ALL SELECT 'INVENTORY', 'WAREHOUSE', 'Inventario' UNION ALL SELECT 'PURCHASES', 'WAREHOUSE', 'Compras' ) seed ON seed.code = ci.code SET ci.area_code = seed.area_code, ci.short_label = seed.short_label, ci.version = ci.version + 1 WHERE ci.item_type = 'MODULE'

rollback.sql: UPDATE catalog_items SET area_code = NULL, short_label = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE item_type = 'MODULE'
